author: makortel
body:
#### PR description:

This PR generalizes the `edm::FileBlock` by moving the `TTree`-specific information into a `edm::TTreeFileBlock` class (that inherits from the `edm::FileBlock) that is defined in the `IOPool/Common`. This way the `TTree`-specific information becomes an implementation detail of the `Pool` (really `TTree`) IO components, and allows later to follow the same pattern for `RNTuple`.

The first commit adds specific tests for `edm::FileBlock` ahead of the refactoring.

Resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2501

Done with AI assistance.

#### PR validation:

Unit tests pass.
title: Generalize `edm::FileBlock`
